text.title: 楼上桌面的报名表
text.situation:
在楼上的书桌旁，杰伊展开一张培训传单。维修正在成为他的职业志向，而不只是其他工作之间做的事情。本地学院开设皮革和织物维修夜课。米娜把报名表放在传单旁。她可以替他照看一个晚上的柜台，但周六还需要他与努尔商量。杰伊希望融入小团队，不把难排的班都留给别人。他在表上写，希望努力把拉链和提手修得更稳定、更一致。写到未来工作的问题时，他停下来。目前，学会做让自己信得过的维修，比选一个好听的职位名称更重要。

维修夜课
技能提升与再培训：发展现有维修技能，或学习新岗位需要的技能。
从事专业维修工作需要专业技能和职业培训。
培训可能帮助参与者提升工作竞争力，但不保证获得工作。
请带一件你想学习维修的物品。

paragraphs.en: At the upstairs desk, Jay unfolded a training leaflet. Repair work was becoming a vocation for him, rather than something he did between other jobs. A local college offered evening sessions on leather and fabric repairs. Mina put an application form beside the leaflet. She could cover one evening at the counter, but Jay would need to speak to Noor about Saturdays. He wanted to integrate into the small team without leaving the difficult shifts to everyone else. On the form, he wrote that he would strive for a more consistent finish on zips and handles. He paused at the question about future work. For now, learning to make a repair he could trust mattered more than choosing an impressive job title.

paragraphs.en:
EVENING REPAIR COURSE
Upskilling and reskilling: develop your current repair skills or learn skills for a new role.
Working as a repair specialist requires practical expertise and vocational training.
Training may help participants become more competitive in the workplace; it does not guarantee a job.
Bring one item you would like to learn to repair.

S08.Q10.P01.function: The form on the upstairs desk
S08.Q10.P01.cue: 说说杰伊为什么想培训。
acceptableAnswers: 维修正在成为杰伊的职业志向。 传单介绍技能提升和再培训。

S08.Q10.P02.function: The form on the upstairs desk
S08.Q10.P02.cue: 说说他怎样融入团队、发展技能。
acceptableAnswers: 杰伊希望融入小团队。 这项工作需要专业技能和职业培训。

S08.Q10.P03.function: The form on the upstairs desk
S08.Q10.P03.cue: 说明课程提供什么，以及杰伊希望达到什么。
acceptableAnswers: 培训可能帮助杰伊在工作中更有竞争力。 杰伊会努力争取更一致的维修效果。

S08.Q10.T01.function: The form on the upstairs desk
S08.Q10.T01.cue: 你想改善工作质量，怎样说明目标？
acceptableAnswers: 我想努力争取更稳定的结果。
